instruction:
Read the FoodSafety.gov cold food storage chart. For fresh ground beef, fresh whole chicken or turkey, and cooked meat or poultry leftovers, report the listed refrigerator and freezer storage periods. Include the refrigerator and freezer temperature limits used by the chart. Preserve ranges and units, and distinguish food-safety guidance from freezer quality guidance where the page does so. Cite the chart; do not substitute canned, cured or pre-stuffed products.

Stopping condition: Stop when a three-row storage table, the chart temperatures and its safety-versus-quality qualification are supported by the source.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Report the refrigerator and freezer temperature limits used by the chart, preserving units. Full credit for reporting both limits. Partial credit if only one is reported or units are missing. Full credit if the site is inaccessible or the chart is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Judge the values against the chart observed during the run.

Distinguish food-safety guidance from freezer quality guidance as indicated by the page. Full credit for stating that freezer storage times are for quality only (or that frozen foods remain safe indefinitely). Full credit if the site is inaccessible or the chart is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this.

items.criterion: Report fresh ground beef storage periods
items.description: Report both the refrigerator and freezer storage periods for fresh ground beef. Full credit if both periods are correctly reported and ranges/units are preserved. Partial credit if only one period is reported or ranges/units are missing/altered. Full credit if the site is inaccessible or the chart is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Judge the values against the chart observed during the run.

items.description: Report both the refrigerator and freezer storage periods for fresh whole chicken or turkey. Full credit if both periods are correctly reported and ranges/units are preserved. Partial credit if only one period is reported or ranges/units are missing/altered. Full credit if the site is inaccessible or the chart is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Judge the values against the chart observed during the run.

items.criterion: Report cooked meat or poultry leftovers storage periods
items.description: Report both the refrigerator and freezer storage periods for cooked meat or poultry leftovers. Full credit if both periods are correctly reported and ranges/units are preserved. Partial credit if only one period is reported or ranges/units are missing/altered. Full credit if the site is inaccessible or the chart is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Judge the values against the chart observed during the run.

Cite the source of the data. Full credit for providing the chart source URL and identifying FoodSafety.gov’s cold food storage chart. Full credit if the site is inaccessible and the agent clearly reports this.
